material_events.claim: MPC entered into a definitive agreement to divest its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries and related midstream assets for $4.2 billion in cash; the associated net assets had a carrying value of $1.8 billion and the deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.
quotes: On November 2, 2026, we entered into a definitive agreement to divest our St. Paul Park, Minnesota and Mandan, North Dakota refineries and related midstream assets for $4.2 billion in cash, subject to working capital, inventory and other closing adjustments.
The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, pending satisfaction of customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.

material_events.claim: The board approved an additional $5.0 billion share repurchase authorization on top of the $5.0 billion authorization announced on May 5, 2026; $3.12 billion remained under the May authorization as of September 30, 2026.
quotes: On November 3, 2026 we announced that our board of directors approved an additional $5.0 billion share repurchase authorization that is in addition to the $5.0 billion share repurchase authorization announced on May 5, 2026.
As of September 30, 2026, we had $3.12 billion remaining under the May 5, 2026 share repurchase authorization.

material_events.claim: MPC announced a 10% increase in its quarterly dividend.

material_events.claim: MPLX increased its quarterly distribution by 12.5%, which the company says results in $3.1 billion of expected annual distributions to MPC.
quotes: MPLX increased its quarterly distribution by 12.5% for the third consecutive year, resulting in $3.1 billion of expected annual distributions to MPC

material_events.claim: MPC reported third-quarter 2026 net income attributable to MPC of $7.4 billion, or $26.59 per diluted share, compared with $1.4 billion, or $4.51 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025.
quotes: This compares with a net income attributable to MPC of $1.4 billion, or $4.51 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025.

material_events.claim: Under crude oil exchange arrangements with the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, the SPR delivered approximately 21 million barrels to MPC, and MPC agreed to return approximately 26 million barrels from April 2027 through July 2029.
quotes: Under the arrangements, the SPR delivered approximately 21 million barrels to MPC during the second and third quarters of 2026 and MPC agreed to return approximately 26 million barrels beginning in April of 2027 through July of 2029.

material_events.claim: The board expanded its size and elected David E. Constable as a director, both effective March 1, 2027.
quotes: On October 28, 2026, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of Marathon Petroleum Corporation (the “Company”) increased the size of the Board to eleven members and elected David E. Constable as a director of the Company, with such increase in the size of the Board and election effective as of March 1, 2027.

material_events.claim: MPLX completed the sale of its Rockies gathering and processing assets for $980 million in cash and recorded a gain of $159 million.

The transaction resulted in a gain of $159 million.

material_events.claim: MPLX completed the acquisition of Northwind Midstream for $2.4 billion in cash.
quotes: On August 29, 2025, MPLX completed the acquisition of 100 percent of Northwind Midstream for $2.4 billion in cash.

material_events.claim: MPLX purchased the remaining 55 percent interest in BANGL, LLC for $703 million cash plus an earnout of up to $275 million.
quotes: On July 1, 2025, MPLX purchased the remaining 55 percent interest in BANGL, LLC (“BANGL”) for $703 million cash, plus an earnout provision of up to $275 million based on targeted EBITDA growth from 2026 to 2029.

material_events.claim: MPC sold its 49.9 percent interest in The Andersons Marathon Holdings LLC for cash proceeds of $427 million.
quotes: On July 31, 2025, MPC sold its 49.9 percent interest in The Andersons Marathon Holdings LLC (“TAMH”) to The Andersons Ethanol LLC (the “Ethanol Joint Venture Sale”) in exchange for cash proceeds of $427 million.

material_events.claim: MPLX acquired gathering businesses from Whiptail Midstream, LLC for $235 million in cash.
quotes: On March 11, 2025, MPLX acquired gathering businesses from Whiptail Midstream, LLC for $235 million in cash (the “Whiptail Midstream Acquisition”).
